text:
ANDY SAPUTRA
Phone: +6281995247372 | Email: andychensaputra@gmail.com | LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/in/andy-saputra-586b22247 | Website: andylabs.site | Location: Jakarta Barat

SUMMARY
Computer Science student focused on Full-Stack Development with hands-on internship experience building web applications across frontend, backend, APIs, and databases. Strong foundation in software development with experience across multiple languages and frameworks. Comfortable translating requirements into functional, maintainable, and user-focused solutions, plus additional exposure to AI, machine learning, deep learning, NLP, speech recognition, and LLM integration.

EDUCATION
Binus University - Alam Sutera, July 2023 - February 2027 (Expected). Bachelor's Degree in Informatics Engineering - System Intelligence. GPA: 3.77/4.00.
- Thesis: Multi-Agent System with Hybrid Approach (NLU, Logic Techniques, and LLM) for Social Engineering Simulation in the "Silent Terror" Strategy Game.
- Relevant coursework: Software Engineering, Object-Oriented Programming, Data Structure and Algorithm Programming, Deep Learning, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing.
SMAS Pelita Utama (Science) - Batam, July 2020 - April 2023. President of the Student Representative Council (MPK) and project director of the school's main events.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Qreed AI - Fullstack Developer & AI Researcher (Freelance), September 2026 - present. Develops and maintains Qreed AI's products end to end, from the AI content platform and internal tools to AI dubbing and automated software delivery, turning client requirements into production-ready features and improvements. Projects:
- QREED AI (main web): Built QREED AI, a node-based canvas where creators chain AI models to generate images and videos. It runs as a monorepo of four Next.js apps (product, marketing, etc.) on React Flow, PostgreSQL and an Express API, with Docker-based deploys. Shipped 31 pages and 170+ API endpoints, fixed bugs on 38 pages and resolved 37 production errors, for registered users including subscribers and admins.
- QREED Dubbing (speech recognition and computer vision research): Built a local AI tool that dubs Chinese dramas into Indonesian or English in each actor's own voice, using Whisper (STT), RapidOCR, LLM translation and voice-cloning TTS (Chatterbox, OmniVoice). Runs speech recognition and voice cloning entirely on a 6 GB laptop GPU, with no paid cloud voice service, while cutting transcript errors from 13% to 2.4%.
- QREED Factory (coding-agent research in a software factory): Operated an AI pipeline where agents plan, write and review code, with automated checks and human-approved deploys (TypeScript, Fastify, PostgreSQL, Docker). Delivered a pilot cafe ordering app (QR ordering, payment, owner dashboard) and caught a credential race condition and a quota bypass before deploy.
Polytron - Application Developer (Internship), February 2026 - January 2027. Builds and maintains four internal web apps for Polytron's employees, HR team and service centers, from interface and API to database, with Docker deploys and AI features in two of them. Projects:
- ESS (Employee self-service): Turned an early build into a progressive web app (Node.js, Redis, Firebase, Docker) for letter requests, room bookings, attendance and push notifications, plus an admin panel for onboarding, offboarding and asset handovers. Became the main entry point to 7+ internal applications, used by every Polytron employee.
- SCM (Supply chain AI assistant): Researched and built an LLM assistant (Python FastAPI, React, local LLM with RAG) that reads inventory and bill-of-materials files, answers stock questions and suggests production combinations from materials on hand. The research became the benchmark for adopting AI at Polytron.
- QMS (Queue management system for service centers): Adapted the queue app for Smart TVs with a large-screen UI and voice calling (text-to-speech), packaged as an Android WebView app. Runs at every Polytron service center, showing customers their queue status on site.
- ATS (AI-assisted CV screening): Built a CV screener that parses PDF/Word CVs and scores candidates against HR criteria using NLP (NER, S-BERT) and a local LLM (DeepSeek-R1 14B), with a Node.js admin panel, all in Docker. Gives HR a first read on every new job application before they review it manually.

SELECTED PROJECTS (more at andylabs.site)
- Silent Terror - Thesis project (Angular, Python, SQL, Docker, SVM, Fuzzy Logic, LLM). https://github.com/Andysaputra1/GamesSilentTerror. Engineered a hybrid AI architecture for a "silent terror" environment by integrating ML/DL models (SVM, Naive Bayes, Transformer LLMs) and decision frameworks (Fuzzy Logic, Utility AI, Behavior Trees), amplifying psychological suspense and delivering an immersive player experience.
- My Invitation - Personal project (Node.js). https://www.myinvitation.cards. Digital wedding-invitation platform with themed collections, package previews, and consultation flows focused on responsive and elegant presentation.

ORGANIZATION EXPERIENCE
- Freshmen Leader - Alam Sutera, August 2025 - September 2025. Guided first-year students in adapting to university life, mentoring them through Binusian values, academic transition, and campus engagement.
- BINUS TV Club - Alam Sutera, August 2023 - December 2025. Former core member and Technical Advisor (Core Development: Media Journey, Glimpse of BINUSTV Club, Buram EXPO, LDKA), mentoring new members in technical best practices, and Technical Coordinator (Buram Expo), managing technical setup and on-site issue resolution.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Programming languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, C
Frontend & backend: HTML, CSS, React.js, Angular, Node.js, Express.js, FastAPI, Flask
Database, APIs & tools: MySQL, SQL, RESTful APIs, Docker, Git
Artificial intelligence: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Speech Recognition, NLP, LLM Integration, OpenAI API, Prompt Engineering

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
Soft skills: strong leadership, teamwork, and communication, with an adaptable and solution-oriented approach to problem-solving and time management.
Achievement: 2nd Place - SIM Business Plan Competition, Batam (2022)
Languages: Indonesian, English, Mandarin (Basic), Teochew
